full_details.title: AI Customer Support Automation
full_details.full_description:
I want to automate our first-line customer support so every incoming message on WhatsApp and the website chat widget is routed through an AI that consults our knowledge base and replies instantly.

Scope of interactions  
• Channel flow: Customer → WhatsApp / web chat → AI assistant → updated knowledge base.

What the assistant must do  
• Answer FAQs accurately.  
• Handle account-level inquiries (e.g., order status, subscription details).  
• Provide personalised product recommendations that link back to our catalogue.

Knowledge base status  
About 70 % of the material already exists; we will need to audit, clean, and expand it so the AI can retrieve up-to-date answers with full citations.

Technical expectations  
The solution should integrate with the WhatsApp Business API and an embeddable web chat widget, use retrieval-augmented generation (OpenAI, LangChain, Rasa, or a comparable framework) for traceable responses, log every conversation, and include an admin panel where my team can review chats and edit content. Deployment will be on our AWS account; please ship infrastructure-as-code or detailed setup notes so we can reproduce the environment.

Acceptance criteria  
1. Messages on both channels receive AI responses in under five seconds.  
2. At least 90 % of test questions are answered correctly, referencing a knowledge-base source.  
3. Admin panel shows real-time transcripts and allows manual take-over.  
4. Clear hand-off procedure to human agents for edge cases.  
5. Comprehensive documentation covering architecture, setup, and future training steps.

If you have proven experience building chat or WhatsApp AI agents, let’s discuss your approach and timeline.
